text_block_list.text:
On the last day of summer camp. Since 
Matikanetannhauser was nowhere to be 
found, I searched all over until—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is it that time already?! I'm so 
sorry! I was just looking for something.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I gathered them yesterday, 
but I forgot to take them home. Where 
could they be...

Looking where she pointed as she said 
that, several spider conches were lined 
up.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, a seashell shaped like a spider~! 
It's all spiky and cute!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, let's display it in the Trainer's 
room! A summer memory, right?

All in all... this year's summer training 
camp also came to an end on a cheerful 
note.
